title: Homogeneous Factorizations Producing Type-II Arveson Systems
exact_target: Construct a translation-invariant noncommutative factorization of the prescribed factor and state whose associated product system has type II.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001175 (OWR-3392-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 29--30, printed pages 521--522.
Tsirelson nonclassical stochastic flows; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The report's factorization axioms, state-preserving conditional expectations, and continuity/measurability conditions are part of the construction; a family of arbitrary independent subalgebras is insufficient. The existence question concerns the given probability algebra, not simply existence of an unrelated type II system.
